component.name: fModLoader
component.summary: Sleek desktop utility for dynamic font glyph modification

description.p: fModLoader (FML) is an open-source desktop application for dynamic font glyph modification. It allows font artists, modders, and developers to create, edit, and apply custom glyph modifications onto compatible (.modcompat) font files — without requiring commercial font editors.
Mods are packaged as .ttfm (TrueType) or .otfm (OpenType) files and can be applied, previewed and reverted with a built-in backup system.
